title: Catalog signal play and doc cadence for new model additions
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Create a concise, repeatable play (signal play) for announcing and operationalizing new model additions in the catalog. This ticket captures the cross-team cadence for benchmarks, docs, release notes, and external comms so that each model ship is predictable, measurable, and can be executed with minimal last-minute firefighting. The deliverable is a single-page launch signal play plus a templated asset pack (benchmarks table, doc skeleton, release note template, announcement draft) and an accompanying checklist for SRE/Eng/Support/Docs/Marketing handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: One-page signal play published in Confluence with owner for each step
Benchmark matrix completed and validated by Engineering for 2+ representative workloads (latency, throughput, cost) and linked from the play
Docs skeleton (Quickstart, API changes, migration notes) merged to docs repo and staged for release
Release notes and announcement drafts approved by PM, Design, and Communications and scheduled in release calendar
tasks: Define signal thresholds that trigger escalations (latency SLO breaches, regressions >5% in quality)
Create benchmark matrix template (p95/median latency, tokens/sec, memory footprint, per-token cost) and populate for new model baseline
Run 3 bench runs across hosted and dedicated stacks; capture variability and attach raw logs
Coordinate with Runtime Eng for recommended kernel/quantization flags and any required runtime feature gates
Draft Quickstart doc and API examples highlighting differences vs existing models
Prepare migration notes for customers pinned to older model variants
Author release notes entry and changelog lines; add to product release PR
Design review: request banner and feature card for Console catalog page (attach Figma link)
Prepare announcement copy for developer newsletter + blog post outline
Create observability dashboard snapshot (latency, error rate, token cost) and add to release playbook
Define rollback/fallback policy (compatible variants, routing policies) and test canary fallback once
Draft support runbook with triage steps and escalation contacts
Schedule cross-functional launch sync (PM/Eng/Design/Docs/Comm) and capture minutes
File final checklist closeout and sign-off from Eng lead and Head of Product
Post-launch 48-hour monitoring confirmation and retrospective note entry
